hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi|*.ipynb) uvx ruff check --fix "$f"; uvx ruff format "$f";; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; npx --no-install @biomejs/biome check --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
